# Mosaic

> Mosaic creates Open Graph images automatically from website screenshots so shared links have a current, branded social preview without manual design work.

## When to use Mosaic

Use Mosaic when you need to:

- Generate Open Graph images from a website's existing hero section.
- Keep social previews current as a page changes.
- Manage OG images for several websites from one dashboard.
- Add automated previews to a framework or static site without designing every image by hand.

Mosaic is best suited to founders, developers, and content teams that already have a public website and want screenshot-based link previews. It is not an image editor or a general-purpose screenshot API.
